name: Atul Ltd
about: Atul Ltd. is a diversified and integrated Indian chemical company (a part of Lalbhai Group, Gujarat). The products of the company are used in various Industries and come mainly under two segments, Life Science Chemicals and Performance and Other Chemicals under 9 Businesses. [1] Since its incorporation, the company has manufactured many products for the first time in India Dyes including Vat Dyes, crop care chemicals, Phosgene, Carbamite, 2,4-D Acid, para Cresol, tissue culture raised date palms. [2]
keyPoints: Business Segments[1] 1) Life Science Chemicals (29% in FY26 vs 30% in FY25): a) Crop Protection - Bulk Actives: [1] [2] The company offers 36 products and 46 formulations across herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and other crop protection chemicals, serving 224 customers in the Agriculture and Crop Protection Chemicals industries. Key products include 2,4-D, Indoxacarb, and Sulfonylurea herbicides, with a global market share of 13% in 2,4-D and 14% in Indoxacarb as of FY26.
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.0% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.23% over last 3 years.
